mission.title: Welcome to the Matrix
mission.description: Your introduction assignment inside the Matrix.

phase.briefing:
Welcome to the Matrix, {player}! I am Tyndall and I will be your mission contact from Zion. I've been looking forward to working with you.
Your first objective is displayed on your HUD. The number on the waypoint tells you your current distance from the mission location. Go there now and talk to Abalakin.

done.say:
Tyndall says you need a little advice now that you've been freed.
Most important: Stay alive. The Machines and who knows who else will be gunning for you. Don't ever assume that you're safe, especially once you leave Richland.
What Abalakin says is true. New redpills have limited access rights. If you see an Agent, run!
Once you've completed your objectives for a mission, don't stay in the mission area. If you loiter at the mission area for too long it's possible that Agents will track you and chase you down!
Once all of your objectives are complete, you and your team must exit the mission area. We don't want hostile Agents tracking you.

Some Exiles in the Matrix have formed gangs. They roam the streets and alleyways of the city. That doesn't mean you can't fight them, just be careful.
Hey, speaking of fighting... I want to see you in combat! Fight this simulacrum of mine. Show me what you've learned!
Why don't we play along with Crow? I've already added your new objective: Kill the simulacrum!
Damn! I see your combat training has paid off.

Nice work, recruit! There's one more thing I wanted to tell you before you go.
Exile gangs have staked out territory in the Matrix, and might attack if you come close. Your targeting HUD colors their names based on their threat level. I won't go into all the details, but if you see purple, run!

near.say:
Inside this building you'll find one of the many Zion bases within the Matrix. Zion uses these bases to stock supplies, create tools and even locate potential redpills.
Find Abalakin. After speaking with Abalakin and Rigel, Crow will want to see you in combat.

complete.say:
You just completed your first mission. I know it was easy, but things won't always be so simple. Trust me.
Exit the building and we can wrap up your first assignment.

mission.finish:
I already see that it'll be a pleasure working with you, {player}.
Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment, Warrior.
